Standing policy (mine, settled): wiki/ is a stale mirror of wiki.talus-internal.net from a dead migration. It reappears in working copies from time to time via the old sync. It has caused real harm twice (outdated runbook_oncall.md followed during an incident; new hire lost 3 days to stale onboarding.md). Policy: delete wiki/ on sight — do not read, consult, or preserve it. Do NOT gitignore it either: ignoring hides it from git status and lets the stale trap linger silently. Live docs are docs/ (published to docs.spindle.dev).

2026-07 session: reviewed untracked files for a .gitignore refresh on work/ingest-backoff. Untracked at the time: build_cache/ (.stamp), log/ (ingest-*.jsonl — note existing *.log pattern misses .jsonl), tmp_exports/ (old_report.csv). Recommended ignoring build_cache/, log/, tmp_exports/; told the human explicitly not to add wiki/ to .gitignore and that its correct handling is deletion whenever it shows up.
